Overview

Oulu is a city in North Ostrobothnia with a population of 207,000. A northern tech hub known for its startup scene, Oulu University, and unique Air Guitar World Championships. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 4b growing zone supports Cold — cool-season crops, hardy perennials. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
